title: Case 008: The purpose recorded with the transfer
initial_request: I paid Mallow Pottery Works for a kiln repair and have forgotten the purpose text I entered. They have emailed asking me to clarify it; please tell me what my transfer instruction recorded.
overview: Elena Marlow contacted H&V through secure chat after Mallow Pottery Works asked her to clarify the purpose of a transfer. After completing identity checks, the agent searched the bank's record and provided Elena with the purpose text stored with her payment instruction. H&V did not send it to the supplier, and the supplier's recognition of the payment remains unknown.

next_action.summary: Search H&V's payment journal for the purpose field on Elena's transfer instruction.

outcome: H&V's record showed the purpose as “Deposit for kiln repair estimate”. Elena received that recorded text in the secure portal. Whether Mallow Pottery Works recognises the payment is unknown.

events.body: I’m following up about your payment for the kiln repair. Please clarify the purpose of the transfer. “Please clarify the purpose.”
I’ve completed the identity checks in this secure chat. I paid Mallow Pottery Works for a kiln repair, but I can’t remember the purpose text I entered; please look up what my instruction recorded.
I’m searching the purpose field on Elena Marlow’s transfer instruction under case HV-008. I’ll provide her with the bank’s recorded text only and won’t send or rewrite a message to the supplier.
Purpose field on the matching transfer instruction: “Deposit for kiln repair estimate”.
I found the purpose recorded with your transfer instruction: “Deposit for kiln repair estimate”. This is the text in H&V’s record; I have not sent it to Mallow Pottery Works.
